full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph shows a young man riding a motorcycle along a straight country road. The camera faces him from immediately in front of the machine at a low close angle, so the handlebars, round mirror, dark fuel tank, and part of the headlamp dominate the lower foreground. The rider occupies the center. Wind lifts his thick curly hair above a serious, direct face, and he looks slightly past the camera rather than smiling. He wears a dark collared jacket with visible seams and cuffs. Both arms extend outward and downward to the grips; his left hand is close and enlarged by perspective, while the right arm reaches toward the far handlebar. A bright circular mirror rises on a thin diagonal stem at left, catching a pale reflection; a smaller angled mirror appears to the right. The road stretches away behind him on both sides as two pale bands converging at the horizon. Dark trees line the left verge, decreasing in size toward the distance. An open field forms a long low dark strip across the right, with a few small far trees along its edge. Above, a wide light sky with fine streaked cloud texture occupies much of the upper half. The photograph has strong but not harsh contrast: the motorcycle and jacket are deep charcoal, the face is softly modeled in gray, and the sky remains bright without losing all texture. Motion is suggested by blurred road edges and windblown hair, while the rider's face and hand remain comparatively clear. Fine analog grain and a narrow dark print border give the image a physical photographic quality. The close frontal machinery anchors the composition, and the empty road and broad sky expand behind it, giving a personal ride a sense of open distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白纪实照片呈现一名年轻男子骑着摩托车沿笔直乡路前行。相机在机器正前方以低而贴近的角度对准他，使车把、圆后视镜、深色油箱和部分前灯占据下方前景。骑手位于中央。风把浓密卷发吹起，下面是一张严肃、直接的脸；他略越过相机望去，没有笑。他穿一件可见缝线与袖口的深色翻领外套。双臂向两侧下方伸至握把；左手因透视而靠近且放大，右臂伸向远侧车把。左侧一面亮圆镜由细斜支杆托起，接住浅色倒影；右侧还有一面较小斜镜。道路在他背后向两侧延伸，成为两条向地平线收束的浅色带。深色树沿左路边排列，越向远处越小。右侧一片开阔田野形成长而低的暗带，边沿零星有远树。上方宽阔浅色天空带有细丝状云纹，占据上半幅大部。照片反差强却不粗硬：摩托与外套深炭色，脸由柔灰塑造，天空很亮但并未丢失所有纹理。模糊的路边与被风扬起的头发暗示运动，脸和手却相对清楚。细模拟颗粒与窄暗印相边框赋予画面实在的摄影质感。贴近的正面机器锚住构图，空路与宽天在后面展开，让一次个人骑行有开阔距离感。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography holds a close low foreground in sharp visual weight while linear background bands recede toward a distant horizon. Deep charcoal masses and bright open gray fields are bridged by rich midtones and visible analog grain. A near rounded highlight and slender diagonals cut across the lower composition, while broader horizontal strips stabilize the far space. Selective clarity keeps the focal zone readable as peripheral edges blur slightly with motion. Natural overcast light models volume without theatrical shadows. The framing is immediate and unpolished, balancing intimate proximity with a large unoccupied upper field and a strong pull into distance.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影让贴近的低前景保持强烈视觉重量，背景线性带则朝远方水平线收束。深炭色大块与明亮开放灰域由丰厚中间调和可见模拟颗粒连接。一处近景圆亮点与细斜线切过下方构图，较宽横带稳住远方空间。选择性清楚让焦点区域可读，外围边缘则因运动略微模糊。自然阴天光塑造体积，没有戏剧性阴影。取景即时而不精修，在亲密距离、大片未占用上部色域和强烈向远方的牵引之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A young rider on a motorcycle along an open country road
theme_zh: 一名年轻骑手骑着摩托车行经开阔乡路
name: Danny Lyon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
